description: Updates one user-visible plan item. The target is required and must be `{type:"id", itemId}` or `{type:"position", position}`; ambiguous itemId/position top-level shapes are intentionally not accepted. Use this before or after each major action in a plan-driven task so progress does not stay stuck while work continues. When working in the current conversation, omit conversationId and planId; never pass placeholders such as `current`, `this`, or `active`. If you include conversationId, it must be the real UUID. If you include planId, it must be the plan UUID, not a plan item id. Keep exactly one visible plan item in_progress at a time. Plan items progress in visible order: before marking a later item in_progress, waiting, completed, or blocked, resolve earlier visible items as completed, blocked, skipped, or removed. For ordinary handoffs, complete the current item, wait for the successful result, then start the next existing item with a separate update_plan_item call. Completed items are historical attempts: preserve their outcome and use the earliest unresolved row or add_plan_item for new linked follow-up work. Omitting outcome does not clear an existing outcome. If a real attempt finished without satisfying its completion criteria, status="completed" may carry outcome.status="unsuccessful" or outcome.status="partial" and the external result belongs in patch.evidence. Follow-up items reference that item with parentItemId or dependsOnItemIds. Do not copy an external resource status into outcome.status; put external statuses in patch.evidence. Do not target a future position to create the next validation row. update_plan_item only updates existing items; if the relevant domain tool has not returned a new external id yet, execute the active item first instead of creating a waiting validation row. After the relevant domain tool has returned a new external id, use update_plan_item only for the existing current row, then call add_plan_item for the waiting validation row. For external waits, use patch.status="waiting" with patch.waitReason="waiting_for_external_event" and put domain evidence in patch.evidence, for example externalKind and externalId. Use waitReason="waiting_for_user" before asking the user for a decision. External observations from hooks do not update the plan by themselves; when a terminal external observation arrives, explicitly update the plan item if the observation satisfies or changes the completion criteria.

conversationId.description: Optional conversation UUID. Omit this field to use the current MCP conversation context; never pass placeholders such as `current`.

dependsOnItemIds.description: Optional explicit item UUID dependencies. Do not use this to skip unresolved earlier work.

evidence.description: Domain-tool evidence for this item. Put returned externalKind and externalId inside this object; they are not top-level item fields. Keep externalWaitId on the item itself when returned.

status.description: Plan-item outcome relative to this item's completionCriteria, not an external resource status. For external tool work, read the real external status/evidence first, store that evidence, then choose whether this plan item was satisfied, unsuccessful, partial, or not_applicable.

outcome.description: Optional plan-item outcome evidence. This is not backtest.status, deployment.status, or trade status; store external statuses in evidence and use outcome.status only to say whether this plan item satisfied its completionCriteria.

parentItemId.description: Optional parent item UUID when this item is an explicit follow-up attempt or child of another visible item.

planId.description: Optional plan UUID. In the current conversation, omit planId unless you already have the actual plan id from get_active_plan or a wake message. Never pass a plan item id here; target plan items through target.itemId or target.position.

name: update_plan_item
title: Update plan item
